scientific_integrity: Full analytic argument with explicit boundary resolvents and Weyl sequences. Finite numerical verification is supplementary, not an infinite-dimensional proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for a single exceptional positive shift weight, not arbitrary weights; it describes Fredholm essential spectra and essential norms, not the complete discrete spectrum or ordinary norms. Priority relative to differently phrased Jacobi-operator literature requires independent specialist checking.
title: A one-spike essential-spectrum transition for symmetric and antisymmetric shift tensors
